title: The Story Department: an AI film studio, read as a company
claim: Code is management and agents are specialists: twenty agents in five departments turn a public-domain book into finished episodes, each agent gets one brief and returns one typed object, and no agent edits a file or reads another agent's answer.

headline.label: five departments, five QC judges, one typed object each

summary: An interactive description of the Visurena studio's architecture as of 2026-10-21. The org chart shows who reports to whom: step scripts are unit heads that order the work, write the briefs, assemble and check; agents are specialists validated by pydantic contracts before anything downstream sees their output. A work-order desk projects every event onto one row per unit, and an animated run follows one book from the EPUB to a delivered episode master. A second tab shows the proposed future architecture, a third the command center that runs it.
limitations: A description of one studio's design, not a comparison against other designs.
The animated run uses illustrative numbers.
The page is a snapshot: the studio's architecture page in its repository is the living version.

changelog.note: First publication of the studio's architecture page as of commit c78fbc1.
